notes: RBox expansion paired with grammar-replace-0010 (the revision makes 'modifies' symmetric). A made-up relation, 'is dross-turned to', gets symmetry and is applied to real word pairs (tall and tower, ship and harbour) that the revision does not use. A yes-biased model passes the direct, the first instance and the cross-lingual questions, which the audit should record.
